'''R10-X6''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was destroyed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] forces during the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Meridian Complex}}</ref>
